verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a hosted AI app builder like Bolt.new, but the evidence pack does not document any retention settings, data deletion, or account/project data purge capability. The Supabase mention of 'tighter control over your data' is an adjacent backend choice. GitHub backup concerns code history, not retention or deletion controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
